Name: AutoWateringCan
Author: YunHikari
Description:
[b]Description[/b][list]
[*]This mod can help you avoid the hassle of clicking the mouse; you can watering just by moving.
[*]Can be used on pet bowl.
[*]Approaching a water source will automatically fill the water.
[/list][b]
[/b][b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Equip your watring can.   
[*]Move the farmer close to the crops.
[/list]
[b]Configs[/b]
[list]
[*]You can customize this mod using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].
[/list]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28722/28722-1729714315-425704745.gif[/img]
Mature crops can be ignored.
Regrowing crops won't be ignored.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28722/28722-1729714426-1240113377.gif[/img]
Modifying the config can greatly increase efficiency.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28722/28722-1729714523-938302612.gif[/img]
Even filling water is automated for you.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/28722/28722-1729714889-1038317109.gif[/img]
Your pet will love you more.

Manifest.Name: *Auto-WateringCan*
Manifest.Description: This mod helps farmers automatically water crops, simplifying the tedious watering process. By equipping a Watering Can and approaching crops or HoeDirt, it operates seamlessly. It features enhanced range detection, reducing the chances of missing any crops that need watering.
Manifest.Author: YunHikari
